# The localisation claims under harmonised evidence references

**Exploratory. Not part of the submitted manuscript.** Generated by `scripts/reference_sensitivity_claims.py` from the per-question ranks in `nq_reference_sensitivity/` and `qasper_reference_sensitivity/`. Claims are quoted from `results/localisation/README.md`; the manuscript pairing reproduces its numbers (QASPER: True, NQ: True).

| Pairing | QASPER reference | NQ reference |
|---|---|---|
| manuscript: QASPER union, NQ first annotator | union | first |
| both corpora: union of annotators | union | union |
| both corpora: first annotator | first | first |
| each corpus by its own evaluator's rule | union | official |
